description.narrative: The objective of the HPMP - Stage II is to develop the second stage of a Compliance Strategy and corresponding Action Plan for the substances controlled under Annex C Group I (HCFCs) of the Montreal Protocol, for the period 2015 to 2020, such that the consumption of HCFCs is reduced by 35% from the baseline.
